decision.reason: [ev-c929ea305a6b] is only a table-of-contents link under "Removed features" in the v2 upgrade guide. It points to a section (#composite-resource-connection-details) whose text is not included. It does not say which field or mechanism was removed, which composites or configurations are exposed, what happens to an environment that still uses connection details, or whether anything replaces it. The linked section body (around the anchor in the same guide) is needed before applicability and consequence can be written.
